title: SDE-1
description: Worked as a Full Stack Developer, contributing to multiple products across frontend, backend. I led the end-to-end development of the admin dashboard for Sydkik, implementing user management, subscription handling, RBAC, real-time notifications, event logs, and seamless customer support integration with HelpScout, along with real-time chat between users and admins. For Klaviss, a US-based real estate platform, I worked on a microservices-based architecture and integrated LLMs such as OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude to automate property data extraction from PDFs using structured prompt pipelines, while enhancing real-time chat modules for compliance workflows and improving overall performance. Additionally, I led the development of Ylore, a travel application, managing a team of developers and implementing Firebase-based authentication, Mapbox-powered real-time location tracking, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and a secure TOTP-based 2FA system for admin access. Throughout these projects, I focused on building scalable, high-performance, and reusable solutions while following Agile methodologies to ensure efficient and timely delivery.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Worked across multiple projects during my time as a Full Stack Developer. For IRCTC Tejas, I engineered a GPS-based passenger check-in system to validate real-time location during journeys, built an end-to-end feedback module across frontend and backend, and resolved critical defects identified during testing cycles. For Wild Wheat Bakery, an e-commerce platform, I developed responsive user interfaces using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, created reusable components, rendered dynamic product listings and detail views, and improved performance through code optimization and efficient state management, ensuring a smooth and scalable user experience.
